title: Trans i18nKey text must stay in sync with public/locales/en-US/grafana.json
answers: Why did my i18n text change not show up / why is there an extraction script mismatch?
How do I update copy that uses <Trans i18nKey=...>?
What else must I change when editing an Alert/Trans string in the dashboard UI?
body: Mechanism: every <Trans i18nKey="..."> or t('key') string used in components has a corresponding entry in public/locales/en-US/grafana.json keyed by the same i18nKey; the two must be edited together (e.g. PublicDashboardAlert.tsx and grafana.json 'public-sharing.alert-text' were both updated in the same commit). Editing only the JSX string without updating grafana.json (or vice versa) leaves English users seeing stale/mismatched copy, since the JSON file is the source actually rendered at runtime for the default locale. When changing user-facing copy wrapped in Trans, grep public/locales/en-US/grafana.json for the i18nKey and update it in the same PR.
applies: Any PR editing text inside <Trans i18nKey> or t() calls in public/app frontend code.
says: The public dashboard share modal still shows old warning text after our copy revision.
Update the disclaimer notice wording displayed inside the public sharing settings dialog.
Text updates to the public sharing alert banner do not appear in the interface.
Make sure English copy in the dashboard sharing popup reflects the approved legal text.
Publishing a dashboard displays outdated information banner copy instead of the new text.
